title: Traveling floor shows and club-hopping
summary: Show girls like the Thelfield sisters made rounds of clubs on Saturday nights, splitting tips with the band. Ernie lists the clubs, and Dejan mentions his dancing daughter.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Because I used to cross the street at Caliente with Chester's Otters and Howard Mandorf. At that time they had flow show girls going around. They used to call them the Thelfield sisters. Thelfield sisters.
And they'd make a round for those clubs. And they would get paid.
And when they'd pick up their kiddie off the floor, they'd have to split with the band. Yeah, split with the band. You see they have a cab charter. They do the show here.
